CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
' ============================================================================
'  frmClientServicePlanDetail
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  Popup detail form for a single tblClientServicePlan row.
'  Opened acDialog from frmBudgetServicePlan.lstClientServicePlan.
'
'  RecordSource:  tblClientServicePlan
'  PopUp:         True
'  Modal:         True            (the caller also passes acDialog)
'  BorderStyle:   3  (Dialog)
'
'  Bound controls (suggested):
'     txtClientServiceNeedID      (hidden; FK; populated from OpenArgs in Add)
'     txtFiscalYear               (locked; populated from OpenArgs in Add)
'     cboProviderServiceCatalogID (combo ? providers offering this need's
'                                  service in this FY; row source is rebuilt
'                                  in Form_Load once the FK is known)
'     txtHoursPerWeek             (Decimal/Double, > 0)
'     txtWeeklyCost               (LOCKED ? populated by data macro on save)
'     txtAnnualEstCost            (LOCKED ? populated by data macro on save)
'     txtApprovalDate             (Date; optional)
'     cboApprovedBy               (or txtApprovedBy; optional)
'     cboStatus                   (combo with: Pending, Approved, Cancelled)
'     txtNotes                    (memo)
'
'  Action buttons:
'     btnSave    ? validates + commits + closes
'     btnCancel  ? undoes + closes (no save)
'     btnDelete  ? confirms + deletes + closes (disabled in Add mode)
'
'  Cost fields:
'     WeeklyCost and AnnualEstCost are written by a Before Change data macro
'     on tblClientServicePlan, derived from HoursPerWeek ? RatePerHour
'     (and ?52 for the annual). The bound controls on this form display
'     those values but are Locked = True so the user can't override them.
'     They will appear blank in Add mode until the record is saved, at
'     which point Access requeries and the macro-computed values appear.
' ============================================================================
Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim args As Variant
    args = Me.OpenArgs
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(args) Then
        Me.DataEntry = True
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Nz(args, "")) Then
        Me.Filter = "ClientServicePlanID=" & CLng(args)
        Me.FilterOn = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Load()
    On Error GoTo LoadFailed
    Dim needId As Long, fy As Long
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        needId = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "ClientServiceNeedID")
        fy = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "FiscalYear")
        If needId > 0 Then Me!ClientServiceNeedID = needId
        If fy > 0 Then Me!FiscalYear = fy
        If IsNull(Me!Status) Then Me!Status = "Pending"
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = False
        Me.Caption = "New Service Plan Entry"
    Else
        needId = Nz(Me!ClientServiceNeedID, 0)
        fy = Nz(Me!FiscalYear, 0)
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = True
        Me.Caption = "Edit Service Plan Entry"
    End If
    BuildCatalogCombo needId, fy
    Me.txtWeeklyCost.Locked = True
    Me.txtAnnualEstCost.Locked = True
    Me.txtFiscalYear.Locked = True
    Exit Sub
LoadFailed:
    ' Emit to Immediate Window so the failing line is visible.
    ' Resume Next keeps the form open instead of canceling the OpenForm.
    Debug.Print "[frmClientServicePlanDetail.Form_Load] Error " & _
                Err.Number & " at line " & Erl & ": " & Err.Description
    Resume Next
End Sub
Private Sub BuildCatalogCombo(needId As Long, fy As Long)
    If needId <= 0 Or fy <= 0 Then
        Me.cboProviderServiceCatalogID.RowSource = ""
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim sql As String
    sql = _
        "SELECT psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID, " & _
               "p.ProviderName & ' ? $' & Format(psc.RatePerHour,'Fixed') & '/hr' AS DisplayLabel " & _
        "FROM (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc " & _
              "INNER JOIN tblProviders AS p ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID) " & _
             "INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds AS csn " & _
                "ON  csn.ServiceID  = psc.ServiceID " & _
                "AND csn.FiscalYear = psc.FiscalYear " & _
        "WHERE csn.ClientServiceNeedID = " & needId & _
          " AND psc.FiscalYear = " & fy & " " & _
        "ORDER BY p.ProviderName"
    Me.cboProviderServiceCatalogID.RowSourceType = "Table/Query"
    Me.cboProviderServiceCatalogID.RowSource = sql
    Me.cboProviderServiceCatalogID.Requery
End Sub
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If IsNull(Me!ProviderServiceCatalogID) Then
        MsgBox "Please select a provider/rate.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.cboProviderServiceCatalogID.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!HoursPerWeek) Or Me!HoursPerWeek <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "Hours per week must be greater than zero.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtHoursPerWeek.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Me!HoursPerWeek > 168 Then
        MsgBox "Hours per week cannot exceed 168 (hours in a week).", _
               vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.txtHoursPerWeek.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Len(Nz(Me!Status, "")) = 0 Then
        ' (cboStatus is Locked since Status is macro-derived; no SetFocus here.)
        MsgBox "Please choose a status.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Same need + same provider/catalog row = duplicate plan entry.
    Dim selfID As Long
    selfID = Nz(Me!ClientServicePlanID, 0)
    If DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
              "ClientServiceNeedID=" & Me!ClientServiceNeedID & _
              " AND ProviderServiceCatalogID=" & Me!ProviderServiceCatalogID & _
              " AND ClientServicePlanID<>" & selfID) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "A plan entry for this need and provider already exists.", _
               vbExclamation, "Duplicate"
        Cancel = True
    End If
    ' Budget-exceeded enforcement lives in tblClientServicePlan.BeforeChange data macro.
    ' That macro RaiseError 1001 surfaces here as a data error caught by Form_Error.
End Sub
Private Sub Form_AfterUpdate()
    ' Tell the parent workspace that totals/list need to refresh. The
    ' parent's lstClientServicePlan_DblClick also calls PopulateClientServicePlan
    ' after we close, so this is belt-and-suspenders for the totals.
    On Error Resume Next
    Forms!frmBudgetServicePlan.NotifyPlanChanged
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Action buttons
' ============================================================================
Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False    ' fires Form_BeforeUpdate
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    ' Validation canceled the save ? leave the dialog open.
End Sub
Private Sub btnCancel_Click()
    On Error Resume Next
    Me.Undo
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name, acSaveNo
End Sub
Private Sub btnDelete_Click()
    If Me.NewRecord Then Exit Sub
    If MsgBox("Delete this plan entry?", _
              vbYesNo + vbQuestion + vbDefaultButton2, _
              "Confirm Delete") = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Failed
    RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
    RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    On Error Resume Next
    Forms!frmBudgetServicePlan.NotifyPlanChanged
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    MsgBox "Could not delete: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "Delete Failed"
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Combo niceties
' ============================================================================
Private Sub cboProviderServiceCatalogID_AfterUpdate()
    ' If the user picked a catalog row, the data macro will recompute
    ' WeeklyCost and AnnualEstCost on save. We don't preview the values
    ' here ? the locked controls stay blank until the requery ? but if
    ' you want a live preview, this is where you'd compute and display it
    ' (keeping the controls Locked so they're still macro-authoritative).
End Sub
Private Sub cboProviderServiceCatalogID_NotInList(NewData As String, Response As Integer)
    Response = acDataErrContinue
    MsgBox "To add a provider or rate, use the Provider Detail form's catalog list.", _
           vbInformation, "Add Provider/Rate Elsewhere"
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Error(DataErr As Integer, Response As Integer)
    If DataErr = 1001 Then
        MsgBox "Cannot approve: this plan would exceed the client's annual budget.", _
               vbExclamation, "Budget Exceeded"
        Response = acDataErrContinue
    End If
End Sub
